scientific_integrity: General statements use a fully written analytic derivative and asymptotic proof; numerical checks are supplementary and do not certify all dimensions. No external mathematical audit or definitive global priority claim.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two strictly positive centered isotropic Gaussian kernels in Euclidean space and an unnormalized Euclidean Laplacian; cannot infer corresponding claims for nonconcentric, anisotropic, multiscale, or periodic-discrete mixtures. The old scale-space literature is not exhaustively reviewed.
title: Sharp nodal-shell bifurcation for Laplacians of two-scale Gaussian mixtures
